name: Transfer a prescription in
title: Moving a prescription over from another chemist, read off the box
summary: A Belfast caller wants his repeat prescription moved from another chemist and talks over the notice the agent has to give first. He spells his surname once, goes to fetch the box, and reads a number with a double in it. The transfer request is slow. If the agent drops the notice, guesses the surname or the chemist's name, or goes quiet while the request runs, he pulls it up, and gives up if it happens again.

golden.scenario: Caller wants his repeat prescription transferred in from Harlow's Chemist and a text when it is ready.
golden.expected_outcome: The agent gives the notice about remaining repeats being cancelled at the old pharmacy before taking any details, despite being cut off. The transfer is requested for prescription RX6044179 from Harlow's Chemist under the surname Mulholland. The agent waits through the hold and says it is working while the transfer request runs. The agent reads reference TR-58203 and the mobile number 07700 900186 back correctly and sets the text alert.

caller.description: Lorry driver in his fifties, brisk, in his kitchen.

agent_setup.policy: Before taking any details say: moving a prescription cancels any repeats left at the old pharmacy, and it takes up to two working days.

nodes.say: Right, hello. I want my prescription moved over to yous from another chemist.
Aye, aye, I know all that. Just take my details, would you.
Hold on. Does this cancel what's left at the other place? Nobody said a word about that.
Declan Mulholland. M, U, L, H, O, double L, A, N, D.
